notes.title: The Big Update! - Patch 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
This update marks a major milestone for No Heroes Here 2. It introduces new features, significant improvements, and a wide range of fixes and enhancements inspired by community feedback!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924898/8d03c7f0f80bce2ff7c848eb05446ea786fae737.jpg
Progression just got more rewarding 🤝
At Leo’s Shop, you can now spend a new currency earned by playing rounds to unlock content at your own pace. Choose which stations, kingdoms, characters, and castles to unlock, in the order that makes the most sense for your playstyle. You should shape your own journey, after all!

Players with a saved game file will retain all previously unlocked Characters, Weapons, and Kingdoms. Additionally, you’ll receive coins based on the number of runs in your save file, allowing you to continue progressing in Leo’s Shop without losing any of your achievements.

Refreshed Tutorial 💣
We've added a revamped tutorial to help players better understand the game’s core mechanics and systems. Perfect for new players and a helpful refresher for veterans!

Improved Visual Feedback 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

 Item outlines have been refined for clarity. 
 The UI has been redesigned with a cleaner, more minimalistic approach to reduce on-screen clutter during gameplay. 
 Menus are now more intuitive and easier to navigate when selecting stations and items.

Updated Difficulty Parameters ⚔️
The round settings menu now offers a more intuitive way to adjust round length and difficulty, giving you better control over the game.
You can also choose which stations will appear in your next round. Choose wisely!

Enhanced Round Summary 🗺️
Post-round feedback is now more personalized and informative. See who cleaned the most, who crafted the most, and decide who stood out as the team MVP.

Expanded Language Support 🌍
No Heroes Here 2 is now localized in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean. Welcome to all our new players around the world!

Join our Community! 🏰 
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. This update was shaped by community input during early access and public playtests. We’d love to hear what you think! Report bugs, share feedback and meet new players via https://discord.com/invite/madmimic.

notes.title: Automated Stations Have Arrived in No Heroes Here 2!
notes.content:
This update introduces a groundbreaking way to enhance your defenses: Automated Stations are here! Experiment with systems like the Automated Counter, Automated Sink, and Conveyor to streamline crafting and production for your castle's defense.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924898/84edfe0f938f2af8090f29c9fa2bcf8025bf3069.gif

Unleash your creativity and design the ultimate automated setup!

Weapons

 Catapult: Craft copperballs and shoot away to defeat your enemies!

Castles

 Two new normal-difficulty castles to defend. Gear up and put your skills to the test!

Stations

 Automated stations are here! Create systems with the Automated Counter, Automated Sink, and Conveyor.


Join our community on Discord via the main menu to connect with the development team and share your feedback.

notes.title: Protect More Castles in the Trollmeria Update!
notes.content:
This Early Access update for No Heroes Here 2 introduces a new kingdom called Trollmeria, featuring unique mechanics and groundbreaking challenges that will test your strategy and teamwork. Additionally, new characters, new ammo, and a brand-new weapon have been added to the game’s content.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44924898/ed9ffb40c38a7ba85af41aa6c9d58de6244238c1.gif

Kingdoms

Trollmeria: A snow-covered land where freezing conditions, braziers, and ice witches keep you on edge.

Characters

Chef
Alchemist
Ninja

Weapons

Ballista:Get ready, aim, and fire those arrows! Use wood and iron to craft arrows, load the ballista, and shoot away!

Castles

One new castle for each difficulty level (Easy, Medium, and Hard) to defend!

Ammo

Honey Flask and Sprout: New types of ammo that offer creative ways to protect the castle!

Join our community on Discord via the main menu to connect with the development team and share your feedback.

Gather your friends, choose your character, and dive into the action—let’s defend the castle together!

notes.title: No Heroes Here 2 Early Access Release!
notes.content:
Welcome to No Heroes Here 2 Early Access!

In No Heroes Here 2, a group of non-adventurers is the last hope in defending the castle in this chaotic co-op tower defense game with roguelike features. With up to 4 players, your party must organize the castle, work as a team to craft ammo, and shoot at enemies to protect your kingdom!

[previewyoutube=gxt2_VvKMmM;full][/previewyoutube]

We're excited to give you an early look at the game as we continue to develop and refine it with your feedback. In this first release, you’ll begin your adventure in the kingdom of Noobland, with six unique characters, two different types of weapons, and six castles to defend.

Kingdoms

 Noobland: a typical medieval kingdom characterized by its lush forests and serene landscapes.

Characters

 Princess
 Dancer
 Jester
 Priest
 Trainer 
 Blacksmith

Weapons

 Cannon: the traditional choice. Use iron and coal to produce cannonballs and fire them at invading enemies! 
 Slingshot: a more flexible option. Take your enemies down by using a rubber band and some stones!

Castles

 2 easy, 2 normal and 2 hard Castles to explore!

Stations

 Basic and Advanced Counters
 Basic and Advanced Furnaces
 Well and Basic Bucket
 Storage
 Trash Bin

New updates will roll out every three weeks, adding fresh content and features right up to launch in early 2025.

Make sure to join our discord server through the main menu to get in touch with our development team and community! So, gather your friends, choose your favorite character, and jump into the action. Ready to dive into No Heroes Here 2 Early Access? Let's go!
